LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade four
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.1: Length
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Length, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade four MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How can you measure distance? 2. Why do we measure distancein real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Team up with peers in purposive groups/pairs to identify the centimetre and mark out lengths of one centimetre using a ruler. Those with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication- AAC.

2. Work with peers in purposive groups/pairs to measure the length of a given object in centimetres using a metre ruler or a tape measure. Those with poor motor coordination or missing limbs could use adapted measuring tools to perform the task. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Team up with peers in purposive groups/pairs to identify the centimetre and mark out lengths of one centimetre using a ruler. Those with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication- AAC.
2. Work with peers in purposive groups/pairs to measure the length of a given object in centimetres using a metre ruler or a tape measure. Those with poor motor coordination or missing limbs could use adapted measuring tools to perform the task. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Length together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: learner measures length of objects in classrooms in metres and centimetres and

establish the relationship between the units.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: learner demonstrates autonomy in measuring the length of a given

object in centimetres using a metre ruler or a tape measure.

Values:
Responsibility: learner takes care of metre ruler and a tape measure while measuring lengths of objects.

29

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Learner estimates and measures the length of a given object in centimetres using a metre ruler or a tape

measure to enhance self-awareness.

Link to other subjects

The learner is able to relate the measurement of the length of objects to preparing planting sites and planting in

Agriculture and Nutrition.
